svg.title: River section: Woodblock wave print
svg.desc: River section (2D): the raft drifts left to right along the surface of the blood river, cut as a woodblock print. Four brothers row on the beat; one lifts his oar as a glowing tendril rises beneath him, glass-lantern cells drift toward a splash, and far below an immune beast's single eye begins to open, so the river is about to hush. A thin vessel line at the top carries the raft's glyph toward a small heart.
